chain_words.nuance: brings an activity or discussion to a natural end
general sense of bringing something to a stop
ends a contract or agreement through formal action
cancels a legal act so that it has no effect from the start
makes an agreement or ruling completely void and without effect

explanation: These words all describe bringing a legal arrangement to an end, but with increasing finality, from a natural conclusion to a total cancellation of its effect.

usage_notes.difference: 'Terminate' ends a contract from the moment of the decision, while 'annul' declares that the agreement never had legal effect.
